steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Doctor, no doubt you already know that the Silverash clan's exploration of the outside world began with my ancestors—namely, my grandfather.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As recounted in Kjerag folklore, he once went on an expedition with an adventurer, eventually returning with a wealth of silver and gold.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: While he did in fact spend over ten years away with an adventurer, in truth he returned with nothing of value.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Only a few bits of literature, some tools that were considered advanced at the time, and blueprints.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: These trinkets would go on to greatly influence my father, Olafur, who became the first person in all of Kjerag to study abroad.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He met my mother Elizabeth while studying in Victoria, where he also made connections among the nobility.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It was then that Viscount Walden became friends with my father.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When I stayed in the same city on my own trip abroad, I received some assistance from the Viscount. I also met his children—Carle and Kate.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Carle was my age, and full of pride. While he saw me as a rival in all things, he was far from a bad person.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, I had the misfortune to learn that he was attacked and killed by Infected some time after we parted.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After his death, Viscount Walden became more and more hateful towards the Infected, drafting a number of restrictions targeting them.

options: I thought Victoria granted the Infected rights.
Yet you passed his request on to us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Realistically, it all depends on the particular nobles running each city.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Different branches of Karlan Trade also need completely different strategies for working the Infected, depending on local conditions.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Rest assured, Doctor. I shall personally ensure that Rhodes Island's reputation is upheld.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now, there's no need to be nervous. I've only received reports of your recent activities. I don't know what your plans actually are.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I surmise that connections with a powerful viscount can only work in your favor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Regardless, Kate is the subject of our concern this time. She was kidnapped—by Infected.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is partly why the Viscount agreed to let me pass this on to you, despite his disgust towards the Infected.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You see, he worries that his own actions may have provoked this, and as such he is willing to employ any means necessary.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The daughter of the Viscount of County Sykes was kidnapped by a group of Infected. They demand a ransom of 100,000 pounds within twenty days, or they will kill the hostage.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Viscount Walden hopes we will be able to find and rescue his daughter.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He is well-known among the nobles of Western Victoria for having his eldest son was slain by the Infected a few years ago, as well as for the strict policies he's enforced on them since.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The laws and regulations the Infected are subject to in Sykes are more stringent than any other county.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: More importantly, Walden's surname is Caster.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The Caster family is very influential in Western Victoria, and if we can form connections with them, it may save us a lot of trouble down the road.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But therein lies the problem.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Naturally, a noble so hostile to the Infected would not normally entrust this commission to us directly. And in fact, it was passed on through an intermediary.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That intermediary's name is Enciodes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you were involved, it'd be reasonable to assume that this might erode your relationship with the rest of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I doubt he'd be so reckless.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A delicious cake, placed before us right when we're most hungry? I am skeptical, to say the least.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I must admit that, ignoring whatever Enciodes might be scheming, this commission is still very tempting.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm inclined to agree.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island has been making moves across the nomadic cities of Western Victoria, to find places we can stopover at.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Considering his renown among Victoria's nobility from his time studying abroad, it's hardly surprising that he would have noticed our movements.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If anything though, he is the one with more to lose from this interaction, yet he is the one who reached out to us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As such, I am forced to understand this as a sign of his trust in you. I can't think of another explanation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your tour in Kjerag earned his 'trust', did it not?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Looks like you understand after all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or rather, I will treat that as being the case.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I must confess I had the same instinctive response, given what I saw of your operation report.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, the mere arrival of this commission proves the value of your trip to Kjerag.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Naturally, I do not intend to pry into your relationships.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I will simply remind you: as our cooperation with Karlan Trade is ongoing, we must be careful how we handle our relationship with Enciodes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Admittedly, your trip to Kjerag has brought about some unexpected benefits.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But you should also understand that what we are about to do next is an exception, and I strongly recommend not getting tangled up with any Victoria-adjacent figures beyond a business capacity.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is extremely dangerous—for both you and him.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Doctor, I've located the target. They're hiding in the forests on the outskirts of the city.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Hardly. All it took was a little asking around, and some tracking in the slums.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: But damn, this city really treats its Infected terribly. They're all miserable here.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: By the look of it, the noble girl's kidnapping was carried out by the only relatively large group of Infected in the city.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Their security was pretty tight for amateurs, so I took some pictures of the surroundings first.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: These are the pictures taken from around their holdout point.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: And this is a picture I got of their boss.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I see, so that's what's going on, is it?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Doctor, I have a rather presumptuous request.

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: Boss, we're running short on food.
If push comes to shove, butcher 'Sand' and let our brothers eat meat.

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: H-How could we do that? Isn't she the burdenbeast you raised yourself?!
People are starving to death, and you're worried about some animal?

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: *Sigh*...
Hang in there just a little longer. After we get the money, we'll change our identities and start a new life in another city.

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Brother, perhaps I should head back home in secret first?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Are you stupid? How do you even expect to get back without any skills? Just stay put like a good little hostage.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: And what did I tell you about getting too close to us? Are you TRYING to catch Oripathy? Scram.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: Wh-Who are you people?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Easy now. I'm here to speak to your leader.

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: Well, you're not welcome here! Get out, now, or you're leaving in a body bag!

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Enciodes...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're not going to invite us in, Carle?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Stand down... Let them through.

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You can't beat them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Rest assured, I didn't bring any weapons or bodyguards.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So what brings Enciodes, the illustrious president of Karlan Trade, to our humble abode?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As I recall, the last I saw you was at that ball eight years ago.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How prideful you were back then, as the eldest son of Viscount Walden.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Yet everyone's eyes were on you the moment you stepped out.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Tch. Damn and blast.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Listen up, Enciodes. I have no interest in waxing lyrical about my days as a noble. I've long since quit that game.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The only thing I care about right now is how you found this place. You and that enigmatic hooded person next to you. What are you trying to do with just the two of you?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'd heard that you died during an Infected riot. Seems the situation was more complicated than that.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You bloody daft or something?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just a little curious.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: If father asked you to come, then please turn back...

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: I will not be going with you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I assume you and Carle planned this kidnapping together, Kate?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And if I'm not mistaken, you must have been the one to come up with the idea.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Yes, you're right...

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Carle's had a terrible time all these years since he became Infected. I've been trying to aid him and his friends in secret, but there's only so much I can do alone.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So you offered to let your brother kidnap you, in order to collect a ransom from your father.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Viscount Walden loves you dearly, and will surely be devastated.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: I know... I don't want to make father sad either, but I just can't bear to see Carle suffer so.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Shut your mouth, Kate!

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: I'm sorry, I shouldn't have brought it up...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: In any case, Enciodes, if you're here as the old man's mouthpiece, I'd recommend you leave, now.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: And if you plan on taking Kate with you, you'll have to ask my brothers what they think of that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Calm down, you two. Although I did come at your father's request, I stand before you as myself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And next to me is my friend. 'Doctor' will suffice.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am here to help you.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Help, huh? Help, charity, handouts. Why not just use your favorite word? What was it again... Ah yes, a 'deal'.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're free to take it however you like.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: In your eyes, I might as well still be that blowhard of a noble who was always showing off.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Maybe if I were still that same man, I would have some chips to wager with you.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But now I have nothing.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You want to make a deal? What would you offer me? And what could I possibly give you?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That all depends on how this conversation goes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: First of all, I can assure you that Viscount Walden will never know anything that happens here.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Hah... I can't remember the last time I had a serious talk with anyone other than Kate.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Even if it's coming from you of all people, I can't help but to think back to the old days.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: At least let me thank you for showing me respect, in your own way. Not that I feel at all respected.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But I knew you couldn't help me the moment you waltzed in here, grand as anything, like the world was already in your hands.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You want to know why I'm alive? How my quarrel with the old man got to this point?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Fine, I'll tell you.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You completely stole the spotlight in that ball, and you wouldn't believe how much that upset me.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So I left the venue early that night, thinking that as long as you were in Sykes, I'd rather be anywhere but there with you.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: And while my head was lost in the clouds, I accidentally ran over a woman.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Now, I'm no saint, but I wouldn't just do a hit-and-run, so I took her to the hospital.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But when we got there, I found out she was actually Infected, so no one would treat her.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The most hilarious part though? That the doctors were all so eager to help me, the Viscount's son, right up until they saw the Originium crystals on her skin and recoiled in horror.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I just couldn't understand at the time. I honestly could not wrap my head around it. I knew that having Oripathy was bad, but I never expected it to be THAT bad.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So my temper flared up and I brought her back home. Made our personal family doctor see to her.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Naturally, the old man was furious when he found out, but I pushed back against him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This all sounds vaguely familiar, but I was busy getting ready to move on to the next city at the time.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: That's right, you bastard. You decided to just up and leave after making such a big splash. I don't even want to know how many girls' hearts you took with you.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Looking back though, I have no idea what came over me back then.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: It's not like I wasn't scared of Oripathy, but I couldn't see what about it made everyone shit their pants like that.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But now I understand how terrifying it truly is. Some patients will straight up explode when they die.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Some don't, but their deaths are still very painful. Heh, better watch yourselves. Maybe I'll blow up too, and take the both of you out with me.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Hm? Hey, Hood, your reaction's pretty different from Mister Cool here. You Infected too?

options: A lot of my friends are Infected.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: No wonder you seem so comfortable with all this.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: If you're that bored, why don't you go hang out with my brothers?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: This is none of your business.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You're really a doctor then?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Spare me. You think I can afford a medical bill?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: In any case, the old man wouldn't let the lady stay in his house, so I had her convalesce in my own courtyard.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: For the longest time, she thought I was planning to do something to her, but it was much simpler than that. I just wanted her to get better.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I was a complete idiot at the time. I'd push back against anyone that tried to go against me, no matter the reason.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The old man wanted to kick her out, so I insisted on keeping her. She thought she'd be a burden on me, so I wanted to look after her even more.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You fell in love.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Damn right I did. It's a story as old as time. A noble and a commoner fall in love, but the family will never approve. Finally, father and son turn against each other.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Only difference is, the commoner was Infected, and the father had a hand in tormenting her to death. So the noble infected himself as revenge against his father.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I see. So that's the basis of both your 'death' as well as Viscount Walden's hatred of the Infected.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Naturally. His son with a bright future fell in love with an Infected and turned against him. Unwilling to admit his own failures, who else could he blame but the Infected?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: And... I was already the Infected he hated the most.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The news of my death wasn't a lie, Enciodes.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The man named Carle Caster died, seven years ago.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Look, you have that expression on your face again.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: What do you think is going to happen even if I do get the ransom?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I share the money with my brothers, then we move to another city and live out the rest of our lives in peace?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: No, we'll still be turned away at every door, simply because we are Infected.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: We'll still be looked down on. We'll still have stones thrown at us. We'll still be driven to suffer in the slums.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Even if we wanted to work, nobody would take us in. The only thing left for us would be to find a cozy little alley to die in.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Of course, the money wouldn't hurt. A few of us have already starved to death.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But how much would that money actually be worth?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: After years of groveling, struggling to survive with my Infected brothers, I finally understand.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The Infected cannot survive.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I've heard of a group called Reunion that was uniting the Infected. And of an organization called Rhodes Island trying to save our lives.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Who knows when their help will ever reach us?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: It may not happen in my lifetime.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But at very least, they have the ability to help because they know how hard it is for us to even survive.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But you. You know nothing.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Carle...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So, you might as well kill me right now. Bring Kate back to the old man, claim his reward.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Or, just turn back. You can even tell him everything, if you want. What difference does it make?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Point is, there's nothing you can do for me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems I've made something of a fool of myself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's go, Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Doctor, I have a question.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Did I act out of line when dealing with Carle?

options: You were the same as usual.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In other words, my usual performance didn't work in front of him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's... Carle?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He's headed out alone... in the direction of the city?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I'm begging you, my sister seriously needs an anti-infection device.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: This is all the money I've got, but I assure you, give me a few days and I'll come up with the rest. Let me take out an IOU on this, and I swear I'll pay it back double!

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Shoo, away with you! Stop coming here to beg every day, it's pissing me off.

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Like hell I'd believe that you can get that kind of money in a few days. That's what every debt-ridden deadbeat says. What's to say that you won't just take the blasted thing and I never see you again?

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Besides, Lord Walden has decreed that we aren't allowed to sell anything to the Infected within the city.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But I can't get my hands on anything like that in the slums!

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I've looked all over to find you. Everyone speaks of how kind you are, so can't you see how desperate I am? Can't you help me just this once?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: This is everything I have on me. Whatever you want, just take it.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Or maybe I can earn my keep? I swear, I won't let anyone find out that I'm Infected!

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Please... I'm begging you... Just this once...

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Fine, enough of that. How could you possibly have anything of value on you?

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Come in. Keep wailing like that, and you might even attract the guards.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Thank you, thank you so much!

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: And get off your knees already, you're going to dirty up my floor.

options: We'll need a spare protective suit.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Roger that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Somewhat.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No, I'll admit it, I'm surprised.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now I better understand why he said I can't do anything for him...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And Kate, how long do you plan on following us?

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Did you know of this?

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Yes, I knew. But there's nothing I can do.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: If I went up there right now, Carle would just tell me to leave.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: I know this is shameful Enciodes, but... I- I want you to help my brother!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He's already refused my help.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: If he were only after the ransom, I wouldn't have risked myself to come here, so... I don't want you to misunderstand him.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: But, you've always been ever so reliable, and there is no one else I can turn to, so please!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll do what I can.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: As you said, I was, in fact, the one to bring up the kidnapping plan.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: And ever since my 'kidnapping', I've been living with my brother and the other Infected.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: While I dare not say that I completely understand their plight, I have at least some idea of what they're going through.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Back then, he plunged a chunk of Originium into his arm, right in front of me and our parents, before rushing out of the house.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: It took two years to find him again in the slums, completely by chance.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: His impetuous temper from before had turned violent, as you've seen, but to me, the biggest change in him was that––

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Even though he's alive, he doesn't seem to be living.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not sure how exactly to describe it...

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: He's gotten himself battered and bruised so many times for the sake of his friends, but he doesn't seem to care.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: And as you saw just now, he'll grovel and denigrate himself without a second thought as long as it's for the sake of others.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: The only person he doesn't care about is himself.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: It's the same with the kidnapping, really...

options: He's never cared about the ransom.
He wants to give up his life for something?

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Kate...?

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Oh no, Carle...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Enciodes too, and even Hood...? Y-You saw everything?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Did you bring them here, Kate?

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: No, I swear.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We followed you.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Lords these days. How easily they admit to tailing people, hah!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Carle.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I already told you, there's nothing you can do for me.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So just stay up there in your ivory tower. You shouldn't feel even a pang of conscience over a pathetic existence like mine.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: It's better this way. For you and me both.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Let's go, Kate.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: I'm sorry, Enciodes.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Doctor, I brought what you asked for.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, were you asking me?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Well, I've been basically watching over you in secret this whole time, so I more or less saw the whole thing.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: And I do have an opinion on it. Since you asked, maybe you can tell me if I'm right.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: The ransom is only part of what this Carle guy is after.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: He does want it, but not for himself. It's for the other Infected who've gathered at his side.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Meanwhile, he doesn't really care what happens to himself.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: He used to be nobility, a young lord. But after infecting himself, he's lived in the city as a beggar for years.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Falling from such a great height has only highlighted the oppression of the Infected for him.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Because before all that, he may well have been one of the oppressors.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: From another perspective, the death of his loved one made him choose the most irrational, impulsive method of exacting revenge on his father.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: And the consequences of that not only banished him to the streets, but also drove his father to ratchet up the oppression.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: That has always been a source of the contradiction in his heart.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: So I think what he really wants comes after he gets the ransom.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: As for his specific plans... Well, the lives of normal people mean little to him, let alone the lives of our Infected.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: So I'm guessing either murder or suicide.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Doctor, that's the direction of Carle's camp.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That being the case, I suppose this is where we part ways for now.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There is one thing I'd like to apologize to you for.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I should have stayed out of this after I took on the role of an intermediary and passed the commission on to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But it would appear that the situation has changed.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll admit, even when you got involved in Kjerag, I didn't feel as restricted as I do now.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You are reminding me to answer a question that I've been avoiding for over a year.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must ask you once more, just how important is this question for you, Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In that case, I'm afraid I have no choice but to produce my answer.

options: Rhodes Island will uphold the way it's always done things.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just as I have my own methods.

options: Enciodes, what will you use to bargain for his life?

steps.text: Three days later

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: To be honest, Doctor, even now I find it hard to believe that you're the one from Rhodes Island who saved all those Infected.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I always thought you were just a legend.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: What I find even harder to believe though is that you came here with Enciodes.

options: We just happen to be acquainted.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: ...Haha, true. It really does.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I really hated that guy, back in the day.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But there was nothing in particular I hated about him. I was just jealous.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I still am.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Setting everything else aside though, I'm willing to place my trust in you, Doctor.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So, if something happens to me... I'd like you to take care of Kate and my brothers.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Enciodes? What are you doing here?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Did you really think that Viscount Walden would risk coming out to this barren wasteland to cut a deal in person?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: What the—?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Viscount has authorized me to serve as his agent in this transaction.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: He... This is his flesh-and-blood daughter we're talking about! How could he... How dare he!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You were the one who kidnapped his daughter. What right do you have to judge his decisions?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Good... Great! This is just perfect!

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: If that's what you want... fine! Someone, bring out the hostage!

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Carle...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: The money for the girl.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Have your people put the box in the middle, then we'll release the girl.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No objections.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Go, Kate.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: (*whispers*) Go back to where you belong.

steps.name: Noble Sister
steps.text: Carle... *sobs*...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems the exchange was successful.

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: We've got the box, boss!

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: If everything's there, then hurry up and run!

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Do you seriously think the Viscount would let us go?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Isn't that right, Enciodes?

steps.name: Infected Underling
steps.text: Tch... Run, brothers, hurry!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: What do we do, Doctor?

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Attacking one of the Viscount's guards would spell serious trouble... But are we just going to stand by and watch?

options: But we don't have to attack them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I thought you'd let them run a bit further ahead of time.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I needed to make sure they got their money. Plus, with their skills, if I let them run away first, you'd just hold them up to threaten me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: 'Make sure that they got their money'... In other words, you never planned on leaving here alive, correct?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Alive?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: What does it mean to be alive, Enciodes?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Does having a heartbeat count as being alive?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Or is being alive watching your loved one's body get dragged away like an old rag?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Or watching other people die in front of your eyes because they can't get medicine?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I don't know how to be alive anymore. All I know is how I want to die.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: It was supposed to be me and the old man dying here today.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I would've told him that his son still lives. Then I would've killed him, and then myself.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: That's all I wanted. My one and only desire.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: So why did you have to stomp out the embers of even that last little bit of desire?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You rejected my help, so I can only resolve this using my own methods.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Haha... that's right. That's exactly the kind of person you are.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Also, I can assure you of at least one thing. The Viscount already knows.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The look of horror on his face when he heard his son was still alive was positively brilliant.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Hoping I'll die slightly more at peace?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Indeed, that was my intent.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Then I've changed my mind, Enciodes. I'll kill you, then I'll kill the old man.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And what about after that?

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: We'll see when we get there!

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Die for me!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You've woken up.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: You... Why...

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Why didn't you kill me? Out of pity?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Carle, when you said that there was nothing I could do for you, what you really meant was that I don't understand the plight of the Infected.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And I must admit, that is true.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As I was returning to the Viscount, the Doctor asked me a question.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What would I use to bargain for your life?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I thought about it for a long time. I didn't want to answer with words like revenge, hope, or the future.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Finally, I reached my conclusion.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will use the lives of all of your friends to save yours.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As of now, all of them in this city have already died. Including you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Next, they will move to one of my branch offices in a neighboring city and begin a new life there.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The same goes for you. Of course, if you have any objections, I will respect your wishes.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: They... aren't dead?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The people chasing them are my men.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: Ha... Haha... You bastard... How arrogant can you get?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I won't deny it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You don't need to worry about the Viscount. The only problem is your sister... I'm very sorry, but you two will have to be separated.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: I wouldn't have gone to see her even without your arrangement.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: She's better off forgetting about this good-for-nothing brother of hers.

steps.name: Infected Brother
steps.text: But... give me some time. To think it over.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You have all the time in the world.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Doctor.

options: We make a pretty good duo, huh?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Flawless.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This commission was originally my way of apologizing to you, but as it turns out, now I owe you an even bigger favor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Also, I failed to help you establish a connection to Viscount Walden.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Truly, a series of uncharacteristic gaffes on my part.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Regardless, this incident has provided me with a novel perspective on certain matters.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Give me some time, Doctor, and I will pay you back in a way that satisfies you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've finished reading the report.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In terms of outcomes, this was a resounding failure. Not only did we fail to establish a relationship with Viscount Walden, we might even be blacklisted by him now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Therefore we no longer have the option of using his network to find a stopover point for Rhodes Island.

options: You know you'd have done the same thing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I wasn't finished.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But from the standpoint of Rhodes Island, you made the correct choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You shouldn't, as you've done nothing that warrants regret.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island has no desire to be involved with that sort of nobleman anyway, unless absolutely necessary.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I might have taken an even more decisive approach.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Although I won't deny that the results would probably be similar.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Besides, we didn't walk away from this commission empty-handed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Although even I cannot predict what effects this will bring about down the road.
While speaking, Kal'tsit pulls out a document from the archive's sky-high pile of papers and hands it over.
It looks to be a temporary operator cooperation request. The operator in question calls himself SilverAsh.
Enciodes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This arrived just yesterday.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can imagine the HR Department's confusion when he requested to join Rhodes Island as an operator.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In the end, I was forced to handle the situation in person, and to cut straight to the result—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He accepted all the conditions I laid out for him, and passed the operator exam with flying colors.

options: No wonder everyone on the way looked so bewildered.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He's waiting for you in the reception room right now. You should give him a tour of Rhodes Island while you're there.

options: This is your way of paying me back?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ensia has been receiving treatment here while working as an operator. As her older brother, naturally I was concerned and decided to follow suit.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is there something wrong with that?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is the end result of a thorough deliberation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Using my clan name as my code name is easy to remember, no?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Carle accepted my offer. Rest assured, no one will know where he or his friends ended up.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Speaking of which, the new monitoring bracelet you gave me is much better than the previous one.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm interested in purchasing a batch myself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps we can sit down to discuss it.

options: Why would you become an operator?
I thought I misread it when Kal'tsit showed me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Are you asking why I signed that lopsided contract Madam Kal'tsit drafted?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is simply a price I'm willing to pay to become a member of Rhodes Island.

options: You know that's not what I'm talking about.
Rhodes Island isn't a good fit for you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No need to be so pushy.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I had any ulterior motives, I wouldn't be going through all this, now would I?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Surely someone as smart as you would be able to guess the reason?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No need to be so diplomatic. 'You don't belong here.'

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must admit, this is a rather bold experiment, even for my tastes.

options: What are you trying to do?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I want to be your friend, {@nickname}.

options: Does the president of Karlan Trade lack friends?
I thought we were already friends.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have plenty of business partners, subordinates, competitors, and enemies. What I'm missing is—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A friend.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I trust we've already reached a tacit understanding, to some degree.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But understanding between individuals is always asymmetric, which is why I do not trust tacit understandings, Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The best way to know what someone else is thinking will always be to ask them directly, no?

options: There are plenty of others who could do it.
A lot of people understand you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Such as?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Enya is doing superbly right now. Better than I could have imagined.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We did reach a mutual understanding, in a sense, but that is precisely the reason we were able to clearly see each others' choices.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All I can say is she would be a very suitable partner, but not a friend.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I realize that Ensia is no longer a child. She has keen insight into a variety of matters.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will give her everything she wants, and respect her opinions.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But there are far more things I cannot tell her than things I can.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis seems to have already made quite a name for himself in your lab, thanks to his talent and personality. He may be knowledgeable about many things, but that is a product of the years we spent together.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He is not someone I can share anything with, and he understands that better than I do.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Degenbrecher and I are on sublime terms, and it is true that she has great insight in many areas.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The thing is, she doesn't care. She deliberately keeps herself uninvolved in most affairs. From her perspective, much of what I do is merely inviting trouble for myself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And I can't deny that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Matterhorn and Weiss... I trust them implicitly, and feel comfortable handing them many responsibilities.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: While I won't say that our relationship as superior and subordinate creates a distance between us, realistically speaking we will always have a hard time reaching a mutual understanding. As the giver and recipient of trust.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So, as you can see...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I can share bits and pieces of myself with each of the people you mentioned.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But for various reasons, I cannot share everything with them, just as they cannot share everything with me.

options: Because they all have ties to Kjerag...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I never wanted to.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just as nobody asked me if I wanted to become head of the clan that year.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've grown accustomed to weighing the value of each and every person I encounter, and designating a role for them on my path to progress.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Within the spheres I have designated for them, I am completely genuine.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But nobody can claim it all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: At the core of my enterprise is the land of Kjerag, to the point that all the people I find around me are intimately connected to the land itself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Most of the time, this isn't a bad thing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, I have realized that I am lacking an objective viewpoint who can criticize or discuss matters concerning myself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Enya and Ensia were still very young when our parents suddenly passed away.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The family's heavy responsibilities fell completely onto my shoulders. For both my sisters and the clan, I could only grit my teeth and pick up the mantle as a Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After a few years of this, I realized that nothing would ever change from simply remaining the head of a clan in Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So I left to study in Victoria, following in my father's footsteps.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What happened during my time abroad would make a fascinating topic for another time, should you be interested.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But judging from the results, I made the correct decision. If I hadn't left, I would never have understood what Kjerag needed, nor what challenges it would face.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A few years later, I voluntarily ended my studies and returned with my capital and connections to form Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll admit the whole process was originally meant to take much longer. While abroad, most of my time was dedicated to studying and networking, though it is not as if I didn't have moments of leisure as well.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Unfortunately though, the alarm bells ringing in my heart pushed me to make my decision early.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What comes after is the history of Karlan Trade's development.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I cannot claim full credit for our achievements, but I have indeed put everything I have into it, and into the land.

options: I know. It hasn't been easy for you.
You want someone to talk to.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems that we share a propensity to tease others.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I won't say I've grown weary, but I've never been one to fail to understand the importance of relaxation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I were only here because I needed someone to talk to... then I would lack the qualifications to be your friend.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: People like us would never say that hard work alone makes efforts worth acknowledging, nor would we use it as an excuse.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Quite the contrary. I want to share what I've experienced in my life with someone worthy of my recognition.

options: But what does this have with you joining Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I originally thought that our cooperation would remain on a business level, but you seemed to insist that your business is inseparably connected to all of us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And you've managed to convince me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag has experienced hardly any Catastrophes in the past, and as such, the people of Kjerag have little innate prejudice against the Infected.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That said, the role they play in society, what they've experienced, what they will experience...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must admit, I had failed to adequately consider these things.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When I issued articles of incorporation modeled after Victoria's statutes, all I had in mind were some commonplace management tricks.

options: I'm not trying to force you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But not enough to become your friend, now is it?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But if were to become friends, you would have that privilege.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I need to gain a deeper understand of the Infected, and of Rhodes Island's business.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You've helped me realize that this isn't important just for Karlan Trade, but for the way I view this world.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And after getting to know you, the simplest way to achieve this seems to be to work with you and Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Which is why I became SilverAsh.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Or, put more simply, friends need to see each other every once in a while, don't they?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've grown accustomed to dealing with others as a transaction, where one party provides something of value and the other reciprocates with equal value, neither side owing anything to the other.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But friendship, family, and love cannot be assigned a value.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As such, I must choose my partners carefully.

options: I'd love to hear about your time abroad.
Do I have the option to refuse?
You're a terrible judge of character.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll be staying here for a few days, so we'll have plenty of time for that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps you will be able to glean some of the secrets of the Victorian nobility from the vignettes I share with you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Obviously. If a third party were present for this conversation, they would quickly discover—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That I did not come here to 'establish' a friendship at all, but simply to have a chat with a friend.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If that's the case, then the same must be true for you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Alright, Doctor, you're still responsible for showing me around the landship.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We can talk more along the way.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: One more thing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll admit that doing things this way may have come as a surprise. Perhaps even caused you some trouble.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But the next time you see me, you should be glad.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After all, nobody is better suited to solve your problems than me. Isn't that right?
